belief_statement: One possibility is that condition only stimulation vibrotactile might adjustment force grip latency, but the evidence is limited (5 findings, 1 studies). Further research is needed.

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of condition only stimulation vibrotactile, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of condition only stimulation vibrotactile on adjustment force grip latency replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is low. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.
